dl_methodology: Retrieves the tokens in each Gearbox pool & value of all Credit Accounts (V1/V2/V3) denominated in the underlying token.

tvl_decomposition.note: The 3 PoolV3 instances on Ethereum hold ~$3.91M idle/lent-out underlying. The remaining ~$18.5M Ethereum TVL is credit account collateral (wstETH, Curve LP, Balancer LP, Yearn vaults, etc.) — borrower-side custody. DL methodology counts both, so DL Ethereum TVL = pool deposits + credit account collateral.

lifecycle_evidence.event: Current TVL $28,472,513 — 93% decline from peak; protocol still emitting (governance live, V3.1 active deployment, Gear staking $99K verified)
